featured_reviews.name: Umair Lucky
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Sanskruti Banquet is truly one of the best venues for hosting memorable events. From the moment we entered, we were impressed by the beautiful ambience, spacious hall, and elegant décor which perfectly suits weddings, receptions, engagements, birthdays, and corporate functions. The lighting and overall setup created a very classy and festive atmosphere.
The food deserves a special mention – absolutely delicious, fresh, and well presented. There was a wide variety of dishes, and every item tasted amazing. Guests appreciated both the quality and quantity of the food served. The catering team maintained excellent hygiene and timely service throughout the event.
The staff and management were extremely polite, professional, and cooperative. They paid attention to every small detail and ensured that all arrangements were handled smoothly without any stress for the hosts. From coordination to service, everything was managed in a very organized manner.
Cleanliness, seating arrangements, stage setup, and overall hospitality were top-notch. Many of our guests personally complimented the venue and the service. Sanskruti Banquet truly helped make our special occasion memorable and hassle-free.
Highly recommended to anyone looking for a classy venue with excellent food, great service, and a warm, welcoming experience

featured_reviews.name: Omka Kadam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of attending an event at Pavte Banquet Park, and I must say it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The park's serene ambiance, impeccable service, and outstanding amenities made it an unforgettable occasion.

Upon arriving at the park, I was immediately struck by the beautiful surroundings. The park is situated in a picturesque location, surrounded by lush greenery and well-manicured gardens. The serene atmosphere created a sense of tranquility, making it the perfect setting for any event.

The staff at Pavte Banquet Park deserves special commendation. From the moment we stepped foot in the park, they went above and beyond to ensure our comfort and satisfaction. The team was incredibly attentive, courteous, and professional, catering to our every need. Their friendly and helpful demeanor made us feel truly valued as guests.

The facilities at Pavte Banquet Park are top-notch. The banquet hall was spacious, elegantly decorated, and well-maintained. The seating arrangements were comfortable, and the audiovisual equipment provided for presentations was of excellent quality. The park also offers ample parking space, which is a major convenience for attendees.

The culinary experience at Pavte Banquet Park was simply outstanding. The menu options were diverse, catering to a variety of tastes and dietary preferences. The food itself was delicious, expertly prepared, and beautifully presented. Whether it was the appetizers, main courses, or desserts, each dish was a delightful fusion of flavors and textures.

Another highlight of the park was the attention to detail in event planning and execution. The staff worked seamlessly to ensure that every aspect of the event was meticulously organized and flawlessly executed. From the lighting and decorations to the sound system and event coordination, everything was executed with precision and professionalism.

Furthermore, the park's commitment to sustainability is commendable. They have implemented eco-friendly practices, such as waste management and energy conservation measures, which reflect their dedication to environmental responsibility. It's refreshing to see a venue that not only focuses on delivering exceptional experiences but also takes steps to protect the planet.

In conclusion, Pavte Banquet Park is an absolute gem. Whether you're planning a wedding, corporate event, or any special occasion, this park provides an ideal blend of natural beauty, exemplary service, and top-notch facilities. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking to create unforgettable memories in a remarkable setting.

I would like to share some genuine feedback that I hope will be helpful in improving your services for future clients.
Compared to other banquet halls in the same location, your pricing appears to be significantly higher in relation to the services provided. Additionally, the rigid policies and limited flexibility give an impression of monopoly, which may not align well with today’s competitive and customer-focused environment.
On a personal note, during my event, I observed that the hygiene standards in the washrooms were not up to expectations. Furthermore, the behavior and professionalism of the serving staff could be improved, as it did not reflect the level of service one would expect at the given price point.
I am sharing this feedback purely with the intention of helping you enhance the overall experience for your future guests. I hope you will take these points into consideration

featured_reviews.name: Sanjeet Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: We attended a beautiful Maharashtrian wedding at Savita Banquet Hall and everything was so well managed. The food tasted just like home — especially the gulab Jamun and Starters. The staff was extremely polite and attentive. A perfect venue for traditional weddings.

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the opportunity to organize my son’s 1st birthday celebration at Savita Banquet, and while the overall experience was good, there were definitely areas for improvement.

The location is great, with ample parking space, making it convenient for guests. The food and catering services were generally good, though I noticed that some of the roti and paratha seemed burnt, likely due to the quick cooking process.

The banquet hall itself offers enough space to comfortably accommodate 150 people, which is ideal for mid-sized events. However, I strongly recommend negotiating a discount, as their rates are on the higher side. I managed to book with a minimal discount, but before the event, the hall was undergoing renovations. While I was assured that everything would be completed in time, this was not the case. The unfinished walls were covered with golden cloths, which was not what I expected given the amount I paid.

Additionally, the changing rooms left a lot to be desired. The floors were dirty, the sofas had paint stains, and there were no mirrors or hooks available.

In conclusion, if you’re considering Savita Banquet for your event, make sure to push for a significant discount—around 30%. Otherwise, I’d suggest looking for alternatives.

We booked this hall for relatives engagement , and there's no parking available, forcing us to park on the roadside.  To make matters worse, the management is incredibly rude and unhelpful. Hoping the rest of the evening goes smoothly. Not recommended for you guys

Avoid this venue at all costs. I strongly advise against booking this hall for any event due to the owner’s incredibly rude and unprofessional behavior.

Despite our repeated assurances that all payments would be settled immediately after the function, she continued to harass us, even threatening to shut off the stage lights in the middle of our event.

featured_reviews.name: Sankar Das G
featured_reviews.review_text: Putri Banquet Hall is a well-maintained, air-conditioned venue — perfect for small gatherings and functions. The space is ideal for events with around 50 to 70 guests, offering a comfortable and clean environment.

featured_reviews.name: Vishw Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of hosting an event at Putri Banquet Hall, and I must say it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. The venue itself is stunning, with elegant décor and a spacious layout that can accommodate a variety of events.
The staff at Putri Banquet Hall were incredibly attentive and professional. From the initial planning stages to the day of the event, they were always available to answer questions and offer their expertise to ensure everything went smoothly.
The food served at our event was absolutely delicious. The catering team at Putri Banquet Hall exceeded our expectations with their culinary expertise. The menu options were diverse, and the presentation was impeccable.
What truly sets Putri Banquet Hall apart is the level of customization they offer. They went above and beyond to personalize our event, making it truly unique and memorable. Whether it was customizing the décor, adjusting the seating arrangement, or accommodating special requests, they were always willing to make it happen.
The venue's attention to detail, combined with their commitment to customer satisfaction, makes Putri Banquet Hall a top choice for any special occasion. I highly recommend them to anyone in search of a beautiful and well-managed venue for their event. My experience at Putri Banquet Hall was truly exceptional, and I look forward to hosting more events there in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Arun Vishwakarma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had my sister engagement at putri Banquet hall. The overall experience was fantastic. The staff behaviour was polite and professional. Food, Decorations, Arrangment was one the best I have came across infact all the guest says food was very delicious.
Overall the best experience, suggesting all to just have a look

featured_reviews.name: Vinit Bhagat
featured_reviews.review_text: Its amazing place to be there, nice view and clean with all the amenities in Goregaon east.Overall good experience and definitely will come back. Supportive staffs, good food, reasonably priced.Nice party hall for Birthday , Engagement, Reception, Naming Ceremony, Sangeet function.Hotel team is excellent. All the facilities are available.We ordered veg and non veg is also available if you want. We booked this hall for Engagement.

featured_reviews.name: Vijay Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text: Highly recommended for anyone looking to host a memorable event. With its stunning décor, great food, and supportive staff, it is one of the best banquet halls.

featured_reviews.name: PALASH DAS
featured_reviews.review_text:
ATTENDED A RICE FEEDING CEREMONY OF MY FRIEND'S DAUGHTER AT THIS VENUE.
ONE OF THE SMALLEST BANQUET I HAVE SEEN WITH EVERY ARRANGEMENT RIGHT FROM CHAIRS TO DJ ARRANGEMENTS VERY CONGESTED & WHN THE MUSIC PLAYS IN THAT TINY HALL WITH EVERYONE SPEAKING LIKE A FISH MARKET IT BECOMES HELL🤣😂
THE FUNCTION WAS AT GROUND FLOOR WITH OUTSIDE LUNCH OR DINNER ARRANGEMENT SPACE TOO SMALL IT ALSO BECOMES CONGESTED WHILE EVERYONE STARTS TO EAT.
FOOD WHICH WERE SERVED WAS BELOW AVERAGE WITH THE PEOPLE WHO WERE SERVING AT ALL NOT INTERESTED IN THIER JOB & WAS JUST WAITING TO GO HOME🤣😂
SO BETTER THINK BEFORE BOOKING THIS PLACE FOR ANY TYPE OF FUNCTION AS I SUGGEST TO GO YRSELF & FIRST C THE BANQUET.
CAR & BIKE PARKING NOT AVAILABLE, BUT THEY HAVE VALLET PARKING & GOD KNOWS WHR THEY WILL B PARKING YR CAR IN THIS CONGESTED LANE.

featured_reviews.name: Avinash Dixit
featured_reviews.review_text: Great banquet hall in Goregaon, Malad, and surrounding areas at affordable prices. The organisers are very cooperative and thoroughly understand every aspect of hosting events.
